nodes.label: Nostr Integration (earmark + post)
nodes.rationale: Pressing [E] earmarks a track to a private NIP-51 list (kind 30001, NIP-44 encrypted). Pressing [P] publishes a public kind-1 Nostr note. The user's Nostr private key is persisted in ~/.config/derpy/config.json (0600 permissions).

nodes.label: Blossom Audio Upload
nodes.rationale: Upload local audio files to Blossom servers in encrypted 16 MB chunks (AES-256-GCM) so earmarked tracks can be played on any device. Uses BUD-01/BUD-02 blob storage, BUD-11 auth, kind-10063 server discovery. Required because public Blossom servers enforce a ~20 MB upload limit and typical FLAC files are 40-100 MB.

nodes.label: ListenBrainz Scrobbling
nodes.rationale: Optional scrobbling via LISTENBRAINZ_TOKEN env var or derpy token command. 'Playing now' is submitted immediately; scrobble fires at 25% completion (minimum 30s tracks).

nodes.label: Keyword Filtering
nodes.rationale: AND/OR/parentheses expression syntax for filtering playback (e.g. 'derpy jazz AND piano').

nodes.label: MPRIS2 D-Bus Service
nodes.rationale: MPRIS2 D-Bus service on Linux for playerctl/Waybar integration.

nodes.label: Offline Earmark Queue
nodes.rationale: Earmarks are written to ~/.config/derpy/queue.json immediately on [E] press and synced to Nostr on next startup when connectivity is available.

nodes.label: Duplicate Earmark Detection
nodes.rationale: Earmarks are keyed by file path; re-earmarking the same file is a no-op with an 'already earmarked' status message.

nodes.label: Track Deletion ([D] key)
nodes.rationale: [D] key deletes the current track from disk and advances to the next.

nodes.label: Default Source Directory
nodes.rationale: Saved via 'derpy --set-default-source <dir>' so user doesn't have to type the source directory every time.

nodes.label: derpy earmarks command
nodes.rationale: Fetches the private Nostr earmark list and plays all earmarked files as a playlist (files missing from disk are skipped with a warning).

nodes.label: Public Nostr Post ([P] key)
nodes.rationale: Searches Bandcamp and YouTube for links, publishes a public kind-1 Nostr note: '[npub] is really digging [title] by [artist] right now! #music #derpy'.
